MAINTENANCE
Jul 22, 2026
SCHEDULED CASH SHOP MAINTENANCE - JULY 23, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled Cash Shop maintenance starting on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 1 hour concluding around 6:00 AM PDT (9:00 AM EDT / 3:00 PM CEST / 11:00 PM AEST). This maintenance will not affect your access to log in or play MapleStory.

Times:

Thursday, July 23, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 6:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 9:00 AM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 11:00 PM

What will be unavailable:
Cash Shop and Billing/Payments.

items.title: maintenanceJul 22, 2026v.270 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 22, 2026
V.270 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update:

KNOWN ISSUES
The Ride or Die Coin Shop will be temporarily unavailable until further notice.
The Operation: Dive Record Shop will be temporarily unavailable until further notice.
The last hit of Erel Light's Eternal Guardian skill is not working as intended.
This will be fixed in the next scheduled maintenance.
Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupons are temporarily disabled until further notice.
The unintended Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupons that were claimed in the Operation Dive Record Shop will be retrieved at a later date.
RESOLVED ISSUES
July 22, 2026
Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter Ride or Die through the Libae NPC.

维护公告  
2026年7月22日  
V.270 已知问题  

已知问题部分主要聚焦于对游戏和社区造成重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖最具影响力的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以了解这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息，或任何新增问题。  

以下为v.270“驾驭闪电”更新中已知及已解决的问题列表：  

**已知问题**  
- “生死时速”硬币商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。  
- “行动：潜水记录”商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。  
- 埃雷尔·光之永恒守护者技能的最后一击未按预期生效。  
  此问题将在下次例行维护中修复。

items.title: maintenanceJul 20, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Game Update - July 22, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 8 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 20, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED GAME UPDATE - JULY 22, 2026

[Updated 7/22 at 1:08 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 8 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

[Updated 7/22 at 1:01 PM PDT] The maintenance has been extended. We will provide an update when available. We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused you and thank you for your patience during this time.

We will be performing a scheduled game update starting on Wednesday, July 22, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to conclude around 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEST July 23).

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

Thanks for your patience!

Times:

Wednesday, July 22, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 5:00 AM July 23

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.270.1.1.
Patch Notes can be found here!
